correctness.rationale: For the specified 99-tetrahedron fixed 16-vertex triangulation of orientable flat G4, reconstructed the graph from actual verify.py facet data: 115 edges, 198 facial triangles, 99 facets. Contracting a spanning tree leaves 100 cycle generators. Independent SymPy Smith normal form on the 198×100 integral boundary-presentation matrix returned 98 diagonal ones, one 2 and one zero; hence H1=Z⊕Z/2. Independently evaluated the explicit integral cocycle y and mod-two cocycle w from actual file: both annihilate all 198 facial relations; orientation basis triangles (1,2,9),(1,2,7) have coordinates (1,0),(0,1). Exhaustive independent enumeration gives 494 triangular graph cliques, including 198 faces and 296 missing triangles. Their exact class counts are null 37, pure order-two 112, primitive free g 69 and primitive free g+t 78, no |free coordinate|>1. A simple simplicial cycle has length ≥3 and 259 nonzero missing triangles attain 3, so 259 systoles. All operations on bounded fixed complex exact integers, not nonexhaustive numerical sampling or mod-two-only homology.
